source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When mail.chat.enabled is false during Preferences initialization, the 1671747 repair removes paneChat to exclude its contents from search and removes category-chat to remove the unusable navigation entry. The same init block removes both Calendar nodes when Calendar is inactive; current code also gives QR export its own later preference gate. This is initialization behavior in this Settings page, not proof of live preference toggling or a policy to disable Chat by default. No search, keyboard or Settings runtime test ran.
title: Remove both the disabled Chat settings pane and its category
